overview_description.description: Proglix is a trusted provider of cutting-edge software solutions designed to meet the evolving needs of businesses across various industries. The company specializes in developing customized software applications, leveraging the latest technologies to optimize operations and enhance overall efficiency. Proglix's dedicated team of experts collaborates closely with clients to understand their unique requirements, ensuring that the solutions delivered are tailored to specific business goals. With a commitment to innovation and excellence, Proglix empowers organizations to streamline processes, improve productivity, and stay competitive in today's dynamic business landscape. Whether it's software development, IT consulting, or system integration, Proglix is the partner of choice for businesses seeking reliable and scalable solutions to drive success.

product.name: E-Procurement Platform
product.description: A digital platform that facilitates the procurement of metal and steel raw materials by connecting buyers and suppliers and providing instant price quotes.

product.name: Excess Inventory Liquidation Service
product.description: A service that helps businesses manage and sell surplus metal and steel inventory to optimize supply chain agility.

product.name: Customization and Logistics Solutions
product.description: Tailored services that provide customized metal and steel products along with logistics support for delivery and supply chain management.
